ocrd-eynollah-segment.description: Segment page into regions and lines and detect reading order with Eynollah

device.description: Allocate models to computation device; can be a single device name for all models, or a comma-delimited, colon-tagged mapping from model category to device name (where model categories are binarization, col_classifier, page, textline, region_1_2, region_fl_np, table, reading_order, but can be abbreviated by glob expressions), e.g. col*:CPU,page:GPU0,*:GPU1. If empty, selects the first available GPU for all models.

models.description: Directory containing models to be used (See https://huggingface.co/collections/SBB/eynollah-models)

model_overrides.description: Map model categories to mappings from model variant to model path, e.g. {'ocr': {'tr': 'path/to/my/trocr-model'}}.

full_layout.description: Try to detect all region subtypes, including drop-capital and heading

curved_line.description: retrieve textline polygons independent of each other (needs more processing time)

ignore_page_extraction.description: if true, do not attempt page frame detection (cropping)

skip_layout_and_reading_order.description: skip regions, only run textlines, stuffing them in a single text region for the entire page

binarize.description: run adaptive thresholding on input image with dedicated model before analysis (may be useful for degraded input).

allow_enhancement.description: if this parameter set to true, this tool would check that input image need resizing and enhancement or not.

right_to_left.description: if true, return reading order in right-to-left reading direction.

num_col_upper.description: Constrain detection of number of columns by this upper boundary (ignored when zero).

num_col_lower.description: Constrain detection of number of columns by this lower boundary (ignored when zero).

headers_off.description: ignore the special role of headings during reading order detection

reading_order_machine_based.description: use data-driven (rather than rule-based) reading order detection
